item.changelog: ## General - Changed backend from RacMAN-EXT to racman, which means major changes in the UI as well as the backend functionality. - Support for Sly 2 is temporarily disabled - Added automatic updater that checks for new versions when app is launched ## Sly 3 - Added Speedrun Mode that includes input display, memory-based autosplitter and run file loading. Use of Speedrun Mode is allowed during speedruns, however only input display and autosplitter can be actively used while the timer is running. - Added autosplitter for Any% category as well as all individual Episode categories
